column_description: Name of the sensor. may be NULL.
Type of sensor (e.g., IMU, GPS). always exactly one of 'IMU', 'GPS'. may be NULL.
Location of the sensor (e.g., Robot Arm, VR Headset). always exactly one of 'Robot Arm', 'VR Headset'. may be NULL.
Description of the sensor. may be NULL.
Date the sensor was last calibrated. may be NULL.
Current status of the sensor (e.g., active, inactive, maintenance). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive', 'maintenance'. may be NULL.
Firmware version of the sensor. may be NULL.
Software version of the sensor. may be NULL.
Manufacturer of the sensor. may be NULL.
